entries.title: Numbers 24:1
segments: ¶Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not go as at other times, to seek to use sorcery, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

entries.title: Numbers 24:2
segments: And Balaam raised his eyes, and saw Israel encamped according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.

entries.title: Numbers 24:3
segments: Then he took up his oracle and said: "The utterance of Balaam the son of Beor, The utterance of the man whose eyes are opened,

entries.title: Numbers 24:4
segments: The utterance of him who hears the words of God, Who sees the vision of the Almighty, Who falls down, with eyes wide open:

entries.title: Numbers 24:5
segments: "How lovely are your tents, O Jacob! Your dwellings, O Israel!

entries.title: Numbers 24:6
segments: Like valleys that stretch out, Like gardens by the riverside, Like aloes planted by the LORD, Like cedars beside the waters.

entries.title: Numbers 24:7
segments: He shall pour water from his buckets, And his seed [shall be] in many waters. "His king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.

entries.title: Numbers 24:8
segments: "God brings him out of Egypt; He has strength like a wild ox; He shall consume the nations, his enemies; He shall break their bones And pierce [them] with his arrows.

entries.title: Numbers 24:9
segments: 'He bows down, he lies down as a lion; And as a lion, who shall rouse him?' "Blessed [is] he who blesses you, And cursed [is] he who curses you."

entries.title: Numbers 24:10
segments: ¶Then Balak's anger was aroused against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I called you to curse my enemies, and look, you have bountifully blessed [them] these three times!

entries.title: Numbers 24:11
segments: "Now therefore, flee to your place. I said I would greatly honor you, but in fact, the LORD has kept you back from honor."

entries.title: Numbers 24:12
segments: So Balaam said to Balak, "Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 24:13
segments: 'If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the word of the LORD, to do good or bad of my own will. What the LORD says, that I must speak'?

entries.title: Numbers 24:14
segments: "And now, indeed, I am going to my people. Come, I will advise you what this people will do to your people in the latter days."

entries.title: Numbers 24:15
segments: ¶So he took up his oracle and said: "The utterance of Balaam the son of Beor, And the utterance of the man whose eyes are opened;

entries.title: Numbers 24:16
segments: The utterance of him who hears the words of God, And has the knowledge of the Most High, [Who] sees the vision of the Almighty, [Who] falls down, with eyes wide open:

entries.title: Numbers 24:17
segments: "I see Him, but not now; I behold Him, but not near; A Star shall come out of Jacob; A Scepter shall rise out of Israel, And batter the brow of Moab, And destroy all the sons of tumult.

entries.title: Numbers 24:18
segments: "And Edom shall be a possession; Seir also, his enemies, shall be a possession, While Israel does valiantly.

entries.title: Numbers 24:19
segments: Out of Jacob One shall have dominion, And destroy the remains of the city."

entries.title: Numbers 24:20
segments: Then he looked on Amalek, and he took up his oracle and said: "Amalek [was] first among the nations, But [shall be] last until he perishes."

entries.title: Numbers 24:21
segments: Then he looked on the Kenites, and he took up his oracle and said: "Firm is your dwelling place, And your nest is set in the rock;

entries.title: Numbers 24:22
segments: Nevertheless Kain shall be burned. How long until Asshur carries you away captive?"

entries.title: Numbers 24:23
segments: Then he took up his oracle and said: "Alas! Who shall live when God does this?

entries.title: Numbers 24:24
segments: But ships [shall come] from the coasts of Cyprus, And they shall afflict Asshur and afflict Eber, And so shall [Amalek], until he perishes."

entries.title: Numbers 24:25
segments: So Balaam rose and departed and returned to his place; Balak also went his way.
